SELECT TO_CHAR(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(r.PRICE), 0) AS total_price, COUNT(r.COMPLETED_DAY) AS completed_count
FROM generate_series( DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 months', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE), INTERVAL '1 month' ) AS month
LEFT JOIN REQUESTS r ON DATE_TRUNC('month', r.COMPLETED_DAY) = month AND r.STATUS = '完了'
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
